summary: Describes a framework for Realm Specific IP (RSIP), an alternative to network address translation. With RSIP, a host borrows addressing parameters from a gateway so packets keep their end-to-end integrity. The document covers implementation issues, deployment scenarios, and interaction with other layer-three protocols. It is an experimental protocol.

eli5.summary: Instead of a receptionist swapping your name tag on every letter, you borrow a real name tag from the front desk, so your letters arrive unchanged.

questions: alternative to nat that preserves end-to-end
